blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As the water sector prepares for the anticipated strong El Niño, which may extend to the first half of 2027, Manila Water continues to fortify its portfolio of additional raw water sources through major infrastructure investments designed to enhance supply reliability and reduce dependence on traditional water sources. These initiatives form part of the company’s long-term strategy to ensure uninterrupted water service for customers across the East Zone amid increasingly variable climate conditions. Over the years, Manila Water has steadily expanded its water supply portfolio beyond the Angat-Ipo-La Mesa water system by developing new water sources from Laguna Lake […]...
